Lesson 12.3 · 48 of 78 · 27 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Subledger, GL and reconciliation

After this lesson you can:
  • Trace a business event into balanced accounting
  • Explain suspense and value dating
  • Design three-way reconciliation and repair

Learning rhythm: read one section at a time, pause to explain the control in your own words, then answer the knowledge check without looking back.

On this page
  1. Operational truth and accounting truth
  2. Hard cases
  3. Reconciliation is a workflow
  4. Regulatory anchors
  5. Where this lives in LoanOS
  6. Knowledge check

1. Operational truth and accounting truth

The loan ledger reconstructs customer balances from immutable events.

The subledger translates those events into balanced debit/credit legs and maps them to the RE's GL.

Schedule is expected cash flow; ledger is actual financial history; GL is institutional accounting.

They must reconcile but are not the same object.

2. Hard cases

Payment allocation, backdating, reversal, waiver, GST, excess receipt, unidentified money, NPA income reversal and post-write-off recovery need explicit accounting events. Suspense is a controlled temporary state with ageing and ownership — not a place to hide unmatched cash.

3. Reconciliation is a workflow

Compare bank settlement, payment provider, operational ledger, subledger, partner share and GL by immutable reference. Classify timing versus true breaks; prevent duplicate repair through idempotency; assign, approve and evidence corrections; rerun totals before period sign-off.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-IT-GRC — STP controls, financial integrity and audit evidence apply to accounting interfaces.
  • RBI-CIR-2025 — Reported balances must trace to corrected source records.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Knowledge check

Answer aloud or write your choice before opening the explanation. If you miss it, revisit the named section—not the whole lesson.

1. A repayment appears in the bank but not the loan ledger. What is it?

  1. Income
  2. A reconciliation break requiring controlled repair
  3. A schedule change
  4. A write-off
Reveal answer and reasoning

B. Independent records disagree; classify and repair without inventing or duplicating money.
